# DriftingMol — Complete Ablation Results (Legacy Static Snapshot)

**Snapshot date**: 2026-03-28

**Publication status note**: the active publication tables are generated by
`scripts/collect_results.py` into `results/publication_summary.md`,
`results/publication_results.csv`, and `results/tables/*.tex`. This document is
kept as the static 15-variant ablation snapshot for provenance. The legacy
multi-property table below uses the old QED-binned protocol; main paper
multi-property claims should use the fair v2 table generated from
`outputs/final_v2` and publication follow-up runs.

**Dataset**: ZINC250K (199,564 train) via SELFIES β-VAE (latent_dim=256, β=0.01)  
**Generator**: LatentDiTGeneratorCFG (20.2M params, 8L/384d/8H DiT, FiLM + CFG)  
**Training**: 300 epochs, lr=2e-4, cosine schedule, warmup=5  
**Evaluation**: 10K molecules, α ∈ {1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0}; single-property
QED uses 20 quantile bins. Fair multi4 v2 disables conditional binning and
selects references by the normalized 4-property target vector.

## Variant Definitions

### Proposed System (Top-3)
| ID | Name | Description |
|:--:|------|-------------|
| F | Full (Dec-φ) | Complete system: decoder-φ + z-diversity + coupled gradients |
| A6 | Single-τ | Single temperature τ=1.0 instead of Full's multi-temperature {0.5, 1.0, 2.0} |
| A8 | No-Div | Remove z-diversity loss (λ_zdiv=0) |

### Feature Space Ablations
| ID | Name | Description |
|:--:|------|-------------|
| A2 | Z-Drift | Drift directly in z-space (no φ) |
| B1 | Rand-φ | Random frozen φ (untrained MLP) |
| B3 | Stop-Grad | Decoder-φ with stop_gradient (no backprop through φ) |
| A3 | Decouple | Separate encoder for drift (not VAE decoder) |
| A4 | Decouple+Z | Decoupled encoder + z-drift combined |

### Head Ablations
| ID | Name | Description |
|:--:|------|-------------|
| A1 | MLP-Head | MLP regression head (no drift, direct property prediction) |
| B2 | Ridge-Head | Ridge regression head (no drift) |

### Trained-φ Ablations (C-series)
| ID | Name | φ source | Loss terms |
|:--:|------|----------|-----------|
| C1 | Trained-φ | LatentMAE plain (R²_QED=0.52) | drift only |
| C2 | Trained-φ-P | LatentMAE prop-enhanced (R²_QED=0.68) | drift only |
| C3 | Trained-φ+Z | LatentMAE plain + z-drift | drift + z-drift |
| C4 | φ+Dec | LatentMAE plain + decoder-φ | drift + dec-drift |
| C5 | φ-P+Dec | LatentMAE prop + decoder-φ | drift + dec-drift |

## Key Findings

### 1. Tier Structure (QED ρ)

| Tier | Variants | ρ Range | Interpretation |
|------|----------|:-------:|----------------|
| **Tier 1** | Full, Single-τ, No-Div | 0.49–0.51 | End-to-end decoder-φ works |
| **Tier 2** | MLP-Head | 0.45 | Direct regression baseline |
| **Tier 3** | Trained-φ-P, Trained-φ+Z, Trained-φ, φ-P+Dec, Z-Drift, φ+Dec, Rand-φ | 0.28–0.33 | Frozen/weak φ ≈ z-space drift |
| **Tier 4** | Decouple, Decouple+Z, Stop-Grad, Ridge-Head | <0.03 | Collapsed modes |

### 2. End-to-End φ is Critical

- **Full (Dec-φ) ρ=0.493** vs best trained-φ **(C2 ρ=0.329)**: Δ = -0.164
- All C1–C5 trained-φ variants cluster in ρ ∈ [0.28, 0.33], close to Z-Drift (0.286) and Rand-φ (0.276)
- Property-enhanced φ (C2) outperforms plain φ (C1) by +0.032, confirming pre-training signal exists but is insufficient
- Adding z-drift (C3) or decoder features (C4/C5) to trained-φ provides no synergy

### 3. Gradient Flow is the Mechanism

- Stop-Grad (B3 ρ=0.011) proves gradients through φ are essential, not just the feature space
- Decouple (A3 ρ=0.031) shows a separate encoder cannot replace the coupled decoder
- Trained-φ (C1-C5) being no better than Rand-φ (B1) confirms: **without end-to-end training, φ quality doesn't matter**

### 4. Multi-property Landscape

- Under the fair v2 protocol, Single-τ reaches ρ_avg=0.598, followed by
  No-Div at 0.580 and Full at 0.560.
- The legacy QED-binned table is diagnostic only; it should not be mixed with
  fair v2 numbers in the main paper.
- In legacy v1, Full reached ρ_avg=0.363, dominated by MolWt (0.686) and QED
  (0.449); C4 reached ρ_avg=0.326 with strong SA tracking (0.571).
- Pure trained-φ (C1-C3) remain weak in legacy multi4: ρ_avg ∈ [0.08, 0.12],
  with SA going negative.
